title: A rapid and inexpensive method for the isolation and identification of Giardia
author: Lyu, Wen

steps.title: Prepare animal intestines
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the host animal, euthanize without pain, remove the intestines and cut them into 0.1 cm segments.

steps.title: Incubate intestinal pieces
steps.instruction: Transfer the 0.1 cm intestinal segments into a centrifuge tube containing adapted TYI‑S‑33 medium (use 0.65 % NaCl solution instead when the host is an anuran amphibian) and chill on ice for more than 30 min.

steps.title: Remove large fragments
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tube at 1000 × g for 1 s, discard the pellet of large fragments, and transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Concentrate trophozoites – first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the supernatant at 750 × g for 5 min, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the sediment in fresh adapted TYI‑S‑33 medium.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C – first
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Replace medium and incubate – second
steps.instruction: Replace the medium with new adapted TYI‑S‑33 medium and incubate at 37 °C for another 30 min.

steps.title: Replace medium and chill
steps.instruction: Replace the medium again with fresh adapted TYI‑S‑33 medium and immediately chill the tube on ice for 30 min.

steps.title: Collect trophozoites
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2000 × g for 5 min, discard the supernatant, and keep the pellet containing trophozoites.

steps.title: Resuspend trophozoites
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) (or 0.65 % NaCl solution for anuran amphibians). Use immediately or store at 4 °C for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Collect feces for cysts
steps.instruction: Obtain fecal material from host animals either directly from their habitat or after feeding the animals for several days.

steps.title: Suspend and filter feces
steps.instruction: Resuspend the feces in water, then filter the suspension sequentially through a 60‑mesh and a 200‑mesh sieve.

steps.title: First cyst centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer the filtrate to a centrifuge tube, centrifuge at 1500 × g for 10 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Zinc sulfate treatment
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 33 % zinc sulfate solution to the sediment, resuspend, and centrifuge at 1200 × g for 15 min.

steps.title: Dilution and second spin
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube, dilute with four volumes of water, and centrifuge at 1500 × g for 10 min.

steps.title: Repeat purification cycles
steps.instruction: Repeat the zinc‑sulfate treatment (step 7) and the dilution/centrifugation (step 8) two additional times (total of three cycles) to purify the cysts.

steps.title: Resuspend cysts
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cyst pellet in PBS. Use immediately or store at 4 °C for up to one month.
